# NBA Hangtime Recompiled vX.Y.Z (work in progress)

**You need your own NBA Hangtime (USA) ROM.** No game data is included; the game code is built
from your ROM on first start (a minute or two, once).

## Install
1. Extract the archive to a folder you can write to.
2. Windows: install the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) if you do not have it.
   Linux: install SDL2, GTK 3 and a Vulkan driver.
3. Run `hangtime.exe` / `./hangtime`, choose your ROM, wait for the first-start build.
